I. Basic Network and Device Permissions

1. Network access (INTERNET / ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE) 
Purpose: connect to your configured cloud model, check for version updates, and load necessary resources. 
Required: Yes (basic networking capability). 
Impact after revocation: cloud model and updates become unavailable; the on-device local engine still runs.

2. Wi-Fi state (ACCESS_WIFI_STATE / CHANGE_WIFI_STATE) 
Purpose: check Wi-Fi connection status for network diagnostics and optimization. 
Required: No. 
Impact after revocation: cannot obtain Wi-Fi state; core functions are unaffected.

3. Multicast lock (CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE) 
Purpose: access this device from the web (LAN web service / NSD service discovery). 
Required: No (only needed for LAN features). 
Impact after revocation: LAN-related features are limited.

4. Vibration (VIBRATE) 
Purpose: voice-ball tap feedback, notification reminders, and other interaction feedback. 
Required: No. 
Impact after revocation: no haptic feedback; functions are unaffected.

5. Bluetooth (BLUETOOTH / BLUETOOTH_CONNECT) 
Purpose: connect Bluetooth devices (e.g., Bluetooth headset, Bluetooth keyboard). 
Required: No. 
Impact after revocation: Bluetooth device connectivity becomes unavailable.

1. Microphone (RECORD_AUDIO) 
Purpose: speech recognition (STT), transcribing what you say into text and sending it to the AI or a local recognition engine. 
When invoked: when you press the record button for voice conversation or voice input. 
Required: only needed for voice-input features. 
Data flow: audio is processed locally only, or sent to your configured recognition engine (on-device sherpa-ncnn / native recognition / cloud STT); it is never silently recorded in the background. 
Impact after revocation: voice input becomes unavailable; text input and all text functions are unaffected.

2. Audio file read (READ_MEDIA_AUDIO) 
Purpose: read audio files (e.g., recordings, music) for AI analysis or playback. 
Required: No. 
Impact after revocation: cannot read audio files.

3. Camera (CAMERA) 
Purpose: photo capture or QR code scanning. 
Required: No. 
Impact after revocation: photo and QR-code scanning become unavailable.

1. Storage read (READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE / READ_MEDIA_IMAGES / READ_MEDIA_VIDEO) 
Purpose: import and export of knowledge-base documents, file read/write, and local saving of AI-generated content (documents / images / code, etc.). 
When invoked: when you perform import, export, or save operations. 
Required: needed for document and file-related features. 
Data involved: only the files you explicitly select or operate on are accessed; the entire disk is never scanned or uploaded.

2. All files access (MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) 
Purpose: full file-system read/write (special permission on Android 11+). 
Required: No (only needed for certain advanced features).

3. Storage write (WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, Android 9 and below) 
Purpose: write to external storage files. 
Required: only needed on lower-version devices.
Impact after revocation: file-related features are limited; pure conversation features are unaffected.

1. Phone state (READ_PHONE_STATE / READ_PHONE_NUMBERS) 
Purpose: obtain device information (e.g., SIM card state, network type) for network diagnostics. 
Required: No.

2. Call phone (CALL_PHONE) 
Purpose: AI call-out feature. 
Required: No.

3. SMS read and send (READ_SMS / SEND_SMS / RECEIVE_SMS) 
Purpose: SMS read, send, and receive features. 
Required: No.

4. MMS send and receive (RECEIVE_MMS / SEND_MMS) 
Purpose: MMS send and receive features. 
Required: No.

5. Call log (READ_CALL_LOG / WRITE_CALL_LOG) 
Purpose: read and write call logs. 
Required: No.
Impact after revocation: related phone, SMS, and call-log features become unavailable.

1. Contacts read (READ_CONTACTS) 
Purpose: read contact information for communication-related features. 
Required: No.

2. Contacts write (WRITE_CONTACTS) 
Purpose: write or delete contacts. 
Required: No.

3. Account access (GET_ACCOUNTS) 
Purpose: access the device account list. 
Required: No.

4. Calendar read (READ_CALENDAR) 
Purpose: read calendar events for schedule management. 
Required: No.

5. Calendar write (WRITE_CALENDAR) 
Purpose: write or delete calendar events. 
Required: No.
Impact after revocation: contacts and calendar related features become unavailable.

1. Precise location (ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) 
Purpose: obtain precise location information for location-related features. 
Required: No.

2. Approximate location (ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION) 
Purpose: obtain approximate location information. 
Required: No.

3. Background location (ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION) 
Purpose: continuously obtain location in the background. 
Required: No.
Impact after revocation: location-related features become unavailable.

1. Notifications (POST_NOTIFICATIONS) 
Purpose: provide a persistent notification-bar entry and voice-service keep-alive prompt, so you can quickly summon the voice ball from the notification bar. 
When invoked: requested on Android 13+ when a persistent notification is first needed. 
Required: No. 
Impact after revocation: cannot summon the voice ball from the notification bar; core conversation features are unaffected.

2. Full-screen intent (USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT) 
Purpose: send full-screen notifications (e.g., incoming-call reminders, important alerts). 
Required: No.

3. Notification policy access (ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY) 
Purpose: read/set Do-Not-Disturb status. 
Required: No.

4. System alert window (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW) 
Purpose: display a persistent "floating voice ball" so you can summon voice conversation and quick actions at any time. 
When invoked: requested when you first enable the "floating voice ball" switch. 
Required: No. 
Data involved: only draws the interface overlay; it does not read any content of the covered interface. 
Impact after revocation: the floating voice ball becomes unavailable; chat, tools, digital human, and other functions are completely unaffected.

1. Exact alarm (SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM) 
Purpose: the "set alarm / timed reminder" tool triggers timed tasks precisely. 
When invoked: requested when you use the timed-reminder or alarm tool (Android 12+ requires manual authorization in system settings). 
Required: No. 
Impact after revocation: exact alarm becomes unavailable; system fuzzy alarm can serve as a fallback.

2. Device admin (DeviceAdmin, optional) 
Purpose: provide advanced security capabilities such as "anti-uninstall / remote lock". 
Required: No, not requested by default. 
Impact after revocation: related advanced security capabilities become unavailable; all basic functions are unaffected.

3. Usage access (PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS) 
Purpose: obtain foreground app information for agent operations. 
Required: No.

4. Modify system settings (WRITE_SETTINGS) 
Purpose: modify system settings (e.g., brightness, volume). 
Required: No.

5. Wake lock (WAKE_LOCK) 
Purpose: keep the device awake. 
Required: No.

7. Battery optimization ignore (REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS) 
Purpose: prevent the system from killing background services. 
Required: No.
8. Boot completed (RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED) \nPurpose: auto-start related services on boot. \nRequired: No.

1. Accessibility service (AccessibilityService) 
Purpose: supports "agent operation" capabilities, such as auto form-filling, simulated tapping, cross-app operations, and reading interface controls to achieve automation. 
When invoked: when you first enable the "agent operation / automation" capability, by your active authorization. 
Required: No. 
Data involved: only while an agent task is actively triggered by you, reads the current interface's control information to complete automation; no persistent background collection. 
Security note: this permission is powerful; please enable it only in trusted scenarios and disable it at any time in system Settings → Accessibility. 
Impact after revocation: automation and cross-app operation capabilities become unavailable; other functions are unaffected.

2. Autofill service (AutofillService) 
Purpose: provide AI-generated fill suggestions in other apps' input boxes. 
Required: No.

3. Notification listener service (NotificationListenerService) 
Purpose: read/clear notifications and trigger notification buttons. 
Required: No.
4. Input method service (InputMethod) \nPurpose: used as a system input method. \nRequired: No.

1. Foreground service (FOREGROUND_SERVICE) 
Purpose: the voice ball and voice conversation keep running in the background to avoid being reclaimed by the system and causing conversation interruption. 
Required: needed when using background voice capability.

2. Microphone foreground service (FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE) 
Purpose: background voice recognition service.

3. Data sync foreground service (FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC) 
Purpose: background data sync service.

4. Media playback foreground service (FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK) 
Purpose: background media playback service.

5. Screen recording foreground service (FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION) 
Purpose: screen recording service (must be explicitly declared on Android 14+).
Impact after revocation: related background keep-alive capabilities are limited.

1. Query all packages (QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES) 
Purpose: query the installed app list for features such as "view package name" and "launch app". 
Required: Yes.

2. Query specific apps (queries) 
Purpose: query specific types of apps (e.g., TTS engines, ACI apps). 
Required: Yes.
Impact after revocation: cannot query installed apps; related features are limited.

1. Health data connection (Health Connect) 
Purpose: read and write health data (e.g., steps, heart rate, sleep, exercise). 
Required: No.

2. Activity recognition (ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION) 
Purpose: read step count and activity recognition (Android 10+ runtime dangerous permission). 
Required: No.
Impact after revocation: health-data related features become unavailable.

1. ACI call permission (ai.aci.permission.CALL) 
Purpose: the controller's capability to call third-party ACI apps. 
Required: Yes (required for ACI features).

2. ACI discovery permission (ai.aci.permission.DISCOVER) 
Purpose: discover third-party ACI apps. 
Required: Yes (required for ACI features).

3. Shizuku permission (moe.shizuku.manager.permission.API / API_V23) 
Purpose: ADB-level IPC communication via Shizuku. 
Required: No (only needed for Shizuku features).
Impact after revocation: ACI and Shizuku related features become unavailable.

You can view granted permissions at any time in system Settings → Apps → Zorv AI → Permissions, and revoke them one by one. After revoking a permission, only that feature is limited and the rest of the app remains usable; if a required permission is revoked and causes a malfunction, re-granting it restores normal operation.
